lines.speaker: Manager
lines.text: Thanks for coming in. We wanted to talk about last month's stock count.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.text: We've gone through the numbers, and they don't add up.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I raised that in my report on the third. The delivery records were wrong.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.text: We've already decided, so there's no need to go through your side.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Can I at least see what the count found?

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.text: The report is internal, we can't share it.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.text: Given all that, we think it's best you resign today. If you sign this letter now, we'll keep it quiet.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I'd like a copy of the letter, and some time to get advice.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.text: HR needs it signed before you leave.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Then please put the reasons in writing.

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: Good afternoon. We'd like you to come to the station to answer a few questions.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Am I under arrest?

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: Not at the moment. We just need you to make a statement about Saturday night.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I'd like to speak to a lawyer first.

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: We'll also need to search your car before you go.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Do you have a warrant for that?

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: We can sort that out later. It's easier if you just cooperate.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: I've looked at the flat, and I'm keeping your deposit.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: The damage was there when I moved in. I have photos.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: It's wear and tear either way, so the deposit covers it.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: And the new tenants arrive soon, so you need to move out by Friday.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Can I have that in writing, with the reasons?

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: If you're not out by then, I'll change the locks.

lines.speaker: Client
lines.text: We're happy with the delivery, but we can only pay at the end of the quarter.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Our invoice says thirty days.

lines.speaker: Client
lines.text: Let's keep it simple. We don't need a contract for this one, a handshake is fine.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I'd prefer to confirm the terms by email.

lines.speaker: Client
lines.text: Fine. But we'd also want you to waive any late payment claims.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I'll need to think about that.

lines.speaker: Client
lines.text: My employer dismissed me about three months ago.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Were you given a hearing before the decision?

lines.speaker: Client
lines.text: No. They said they had already decided, so there was no need to hear my side.

lines.speaker: Client
lines.text: They also cut my salary before that, without asking me.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Did you sign anything when you left?

lines.speaker: Client
lines.text: They wanted me to sign a letter to drop my claims, but I didn't.

lines.speaker: Relative
lines.text: Now that your father has passed, the family has decided the house goes to your uncle.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Was there a will?

lines.speaker: Relative
lines.text: There's no need to discuss it. Just sign this paper today so we can transfer it.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I'd like a copy, and some time to read it.

lines.speaker: Relative
lines.text: You'll have to move out by the end of the month.
